display_title: 东方异域见闻 ~ Touhou Dystopian

reviews.text: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44181848/] 【更多适合Steam Deck的好游戏推荐，请关注GPD掌机鉴赏家！】[/url] 首先，完美适配手柄，掌机体验极佳。 诚意满满的东方同人佳作，甚至给了我很大惊喜。作为Kay Lnk开发的首款游戏，展现出了惊人的完成度，尤其是硬核弹幕战斗与肉鸽部分达到了很高水准，完全不像一个新人开发者。 令我印象最深刻的是​​流畅而富有深度的战斗系统​​。所有主角同时拥有近战和远程攻击方式，可以在战斗中灵活切换。轻击、重击、闪避、弹幕射击和特殊技能之间的衔接无比流畅，打破了传统动作游戏的僵硬感，很有点当年玩《新光神话》的快感。 如果你是一名东方爱好者，或者喜欢《哈迪斯》式的动作肉鸽游戏，那么《东方异域见闻》绝对是你不容错过的佳作。它展现了同人游戏的无限可能性，也让我对开发团队未来的作品充满期待。 战斗爽感：10/10 ​​视觉表现​​：8/10 ​​重复可玩性​​：9/10 ​​游戏整体体验​​：9/10
非常好玩的东方同人动作类肉鸽游戏，使我的半灵麻薯旋转。

its a neat hack n slash but there is little to no variety and the gameplay is very repetitive. I've unlocked all the difficulty options and it's just number go up as well, gameplay is largely the same. I don't actively hate the game but it feels like there isn't much to do and the combat is very simple.

NO! Just no. This game is awful. People comparing it to Nier:Automata? They must be joking. People comparing it to Touhou? Sure, characters are there but that's it. Voice acting is awful, graphics horrendous, gameplay just hack and slash. Music? The thing that got me in to this genre? Awful! Reused songs from previous games autotuned into a whole new world of hell. Fan or not, stay away from this game.
优点是动作，玩了一会闪退了几次，闪避不太好用，有点僵硬，关卡少，没选择性，天赋简单，藏品也少，现阶段不太推荐。
很好玩的肉鸽动作游戏，每个职业有自己单独的还有通用的技能点，经典的通关一小关，三选一，然后来一个小boss，音乐很带感，音效，手柄适配都不错。配音配音！！！！！！超级好听，哈哈哈红萝莉的CV是谁啊，太幼女了，哈哈哈，轮大剑就是嘿嘿嘿，啊我的心都融化了，救命啊！！！！！！

首先游戏很好玩这是没有争议的，在最近看到的同人作品里相当优秀，但是生硬的闪避和愚蠢的体力槽对于节奏和心流的影响非常灾难，低难度下不明显，但在高难度下随着敌人攻击欲望的提升，就能非常明显的体验到闪避僵硬无比的手感和即使升到五格也完全不够用的体力槽，回复速度过慢，消耗过大，也没有任何弥补的办法，对于妖梦这种需要频繁用到的角色的体验是毁灭性的，一旦空精就意味着巨大损失甚至是直接等死，性能跟不上手的挫败感非常强，恳请希望能够优化一下（PS.反正都是好评不差我这个）

感觉二小姐需要增强一点，三蓄期间即使霸体减伤也会挨很多打，本身回复手段又看脸，稍微上点强度就不得不放弃三蓄提前释放，给三蓄加个甩出去格挡到了东西会恢复之类的可能会好点。要是拿的一蓄的冲击波倒是没那么笨，但是和妹红和妖梦相比DPS和机动性还是差了不少，比较爽的点就是在三蓄蓄满甩出去的瞬间开大看爆炸伤害，但是打BOSS的时候又没有那么多机会一直蓄力，蓄满了BOSS拉远发波，又会导致不得不提前释放砍子弹，导致玩起来比较憋屈。 所以求求了，增强我们芙兰罢

my main first impression is that it's very unoptimize. i have to set the resolution all the way to 800x600 and lowest setting just to pass 30 fps. i don't mind the lower texture or shadow but i at least want to play on 16:9 resolution. the UI very confusing. like these large blocks only with small text in the middle feels very wasteful. what do the purple currency are used for and why do i want to get debuff for me from the shine just to gain more of it? i cant really look at my familiar do. why do i need to unlock the tv just to reroll the familiar, like can i just have all of them at once? why can you redraw the shrine bonus mid run? and why does the upgrade feels very underwhelming? like i got to pick one out of three identical looking buffs to my run, that's not very exciting. i feel like this game is still very unpolished, but i do see a lot of potential. all of the playable characters are very unique, the gameplay is simple and smooth and i like the little voice acting. but right now i don't really want to play more of this game due to all the problems. but maybe if the added Meiling as playable character i will change this review good.

又开始带芙兰朵露节奏了，我真是服了 芙兰朵露是这个游戏唯一的最强自机，已经和蕾米莉亚融为一体（物理），成了红魔馆的底层逻辑，成名绝技三蓄弹刀接登龙给boss们带来了这个游戏最帅的操作，创造了東异的黄金时代。我很难想象一个精神状态正常的東异玩家为什么会做出“不玩芙兰朵露”这种选择。芙兰朵露惊为天人的设计与颇为不俗的机制，可以说目前東异所有自机中最优秀的，没有之一。没有玩芙兰朵露的人失去的不仅仅是游戏的体验，而是一种最基本的游戏理解与精神信仰。芙兰朵露明明可以用操作将大家带入一个全新的人生高度，可是你竟然放弃了。一辈子都将会坠入冰冷的深渊，体验绝望的后悔与没落感。玩東异不玩芙兰朵露，就像四大名著不看红楼梦，说明这个人文学造诣和自我修养不足，他理解不了这种内在的阳春白雪的高雅艺术，他只能看到外表的辞藻堆砌，参不透其中深奥的精神内核，他整个人的层次就卡在这里了，只能度过一个相对失败的人生。玩東异，不玩芙兰朵露，那玩什么呢？没错，无非就是妖梦，妹红，魔理沙这种无脑自机；这样不玩芙兰朵露的玩家，素质品味修养真的很低。古语有云：三天不玩，脑袋爆炸；两天不碰，蚂蚁在爬。这就是说東异要玩就得玩芙兰，那些玩東异不玩芙兰的人只能说他们只会一味的自我安慰而不懂操作。而如鄙人般的高端人士，却与这种陋习背道而驰：玩東异，就得玩芙兰！就得三蓄弹刀！相较于那些不玩芙兰的人，素质整整提高了两个档次。任何事做到极致都是顶级操作，玩芙兰，只要你会玩芙兰，芙兰玩得够好，玩得够神。那么，你就是一个地地道道的操作之神，就算是ZUN、也不能否认你的操作手法。而那些不玩芙兰的人，只能说他们，完全不懂操作，只会玩无脑自机，只为赢而玩妹红，根本没有把这种行为上升到操作的高度。

The game is fun, but the performance is terrible. This game is listed as "playable" on Steam Deck, but I hardly think that's true. Game drops below 30 quite a bit and it just isn't a stable experience. I had to move over to my home gaming PC to even play this game, and even then I was surprised by the lower than expected performance and how hot it made my 3080. I think it goes without saying, but this game isn't a looker. It's simply very unoptimized. If they ever fix the performance issues, I'll change my review.

Unfortunately, the game runs poorly on my system, even though I have a 3070 Ti that should handle it with ease. For a game with minimal assets and simple visuals, performance shouldn’t be an issue - yet running it on the highest settings causes major frame rate drops. On medium settings, it performs better but still experiences frequent dips. Aside from the optimization problems, the gameplay itself is fantastic. The environments feel a bit stale and repetitive, but the excellent combat and mechanics more than make up for it. Just don’t expect a narrative-driven experience like Hades lol. I am going to give a thumbs down for now until they fix the optimization issues

非常棒的动作肉鸽，手感非常好，每个武器都有各自特点和各自的手感，我开大三段蓄力火刀砍下去砍半管血谁不喊一声卧槽牛逼！ 游戏还有个麦克风功能，可以自己起名字并喊出名字使角色完成对应指令，不过我在宿舍那种事情还是太羞耻了我做不到哈哈 体量不大，半小时就能开一把爽玩，全成就二十小时不到，每个角色都有轮椅流派手残党的福音，骑扫把真的是担架啊还是那种带氧气面罩的担架哈哈 游戏目前流程比较短，后面成长属性点满了就基本没什么新鲜的地方了 ，后面应该会开创意工坊游戏寿命应该能提高很多。 浏览器模之屋里的VRM模型都可以直接导到游戏里面，换衣服很方便(●'◡'●)

游戏还行，单纯玩二小姐玩的有点红，其他三个角色各有各的轮椅。 总体来说这游戏最高难度数值不鼓励任何动作游戏的尝试，蓄力半天还不如妹红飞翔脚踢两脚， 尼禄红刀、蓄力格挡、普攻长连段基本玩起来都是纯折磨，数值还是得好好打磨下。
魔理沙这个boss也太恶心了，就知道坐在扫帚上当马拉松b，差评！还有那个妹红跟芙兰，两个b开个大直接锁血拒绝交互，恶心！叫魂魄妖梦的白毛更是嗯玩那个炯眼剑招架b。 非常不错的同人肉鸽，什么时候把无尽模式端上来啊，经常意犹未尽。
差评，卸载。玩得没意思，太保守了，不够爽。 boss一直有护盾，打破了又生成。而没有天赋可以针对破盾的，近战上去，也没霸体，一直打得很憋屈。 我是手残党，所以我觉得玩得不够爽，没有给手残党一个爽的体验。 跟苍翼比起来差远了。至少别人有的英雄对手残党很好，也能玩得很爽。想要玩操作，也有能操作英雄。这才叫游戏。
卧槽为啥我玩的好头晕啊，视角锁定和移动好大的惯性。（锁60帧会好一些）主要问题是锁定之后敌人不在屏幕中间，锁定了移动敌人就到屏幕边缘了，而不是像二人转一样绕圈。攻击方向改为按键时有角度偏差无论键盘还是手柄（搞得跟怪猎一样）... 改为方向则利好鼠标，手柄要么改键要么右手C手

去掉40元的定价和粉丝向这两个标签，作为一款动作游戏并不合格。 - [b]把怪物的体积变得大一点！[/b]：如果我看不清敌人的动作，我会觉得被打到非常的unfair——即便这款游戏的攻击指示主要是依赖各种闪光，我还是很迫切的想要能看清敌人。小怪有时候会和自己发射的弹幕一样大，出现弹幕里藏小怪的问题。把boss做成和玩家差不多的体型也少了很多压迫感。 - [b]想要能看清和弹幕的距离！[/b]：敌人尚有护甲的时候，玩家和敌人还处在互扔弹幕的立回阶段。这时候可以把视角调整成稍微俯视的感觉，好让玩家看清自身和弹幕的距离。因为打开了视角自动回正，即使手动调整视角也经常会被拉回平视视角。 - [b]我该看哪里？[/b]：游戏的色调选择简直是高饱地狱。除了玩久了累眼睛，也不太好传递重要信息。让场景的饱和度下降，让怪物和特效的饱和度上升，整理清楚不同视觉要素的优先级，让玩家不错过重要的提示，这是一个动作游戏要有的基本素质。 这是我首次游玩的初次印象，如果继续玩下去我能看到一些别出心裁的设计，或者游戏后续的更新能逐渐提升游戏的质量，我相当乐意把差评改成好评。
我们妹红玩家还是太有操作了（ ps:我因为玩魔理沙1s没笑被确诊玉玉症了（ 顺便我提名异域见闻为2025年东方同人游戏最佳剧情奖。（
没有原神有人情味，遇到边界派蒙至少还会提醒你“前面的区域以后再来探索吧”，这就只有空气墙挡着
对于手残党（我）来说比较友好，不过boss的技能在难度变化下都一样这一点有点遗憾。探女的语音控制真的很有意思~ 另外，[spoiler] 为什么大家的胖次都一样 [/spoiler]
东方同人里挺稀奇的3D动作肉鸽，美术音乐还可以，但感觉建模有点糙了（还是说画风如此？），角色不说粗糙但也不好看，可能这一块要创意工坊帮一下（？）（我想要我更可爱的恋恋=(。 流畅度很不错，特效也很好，打起来还是很爽的，但是过于线性和重复的关卡打多了会感觉很无聊，如果能像dead cells那样能走分线什么的说不定会蛮有意思的？ 剧情这一块约等于棍木，一通砍砍砍最后冷不丁告诉我幻想乡没了，挠挠头。
Rouguelike dmc, me gusto mucho. edit: volvía instalar el juego y el save no existía, por lo que perdí todo el progreso. También el juego tiene bastante stuttering raro.

Feels more like a tech demo than a fully released game. Every run feels the same, characters aren't different enough, the combat feels clunky, and barely even counts as a roguelike. If this game continued to get new content post-release, then I wouldn't be this disappointed. Unfortunately, this game is just the demo but with 2 extra characters.

[h1][b] TLDR: A roguelite with a good soundtrack but little else. Repetitive stage order and bland builds don’t make it a bad game, just painfully average. [/b] [/h1] [h1]PROS: [/h1] ➕Workshop mods ➕Music [h1]NEUTRALS: [/h1] 🔹4 different styles of combat (characters) with different builds, but the builds are not different or fun enough [h1]CONS: [/h1] ➖Stages feel samey and get repetitive ➖Seems like a balance issue with the different characters [h1] [b] Content (Game world/Narrative) – [3/10] [/b] [/h1] The game world consists of small stages with differing biomes - a city, an ice lake, a library, ect. Each of these stages serve as a battleground for combat and are very small. They have no secrets or hidden things (that I could tell) and always go in the same order for the biomes. The stages are quite disappointing and serve no purpose other than combat for a few seconds. Even the boss stages, which are around ~2x the size of non-boss stages, are just bigger nothingness. There seems to be a story, but it’s disjointed, unimportant, and not a focus. Nothing is really explained. Full disclaimer though - I know nothing about the “Touhou” universe, so its very likely references and character names are lost on me. [h1][b] Gameplay (Mechanics/Difficulty) – [5/10] [/b] [/h1] The gameplay loop consists of picking a class (character) out of 4, and running through stages killing enemies and bosses. You have 3 enemy stages before a boss, and after each stage you choose an upgrade that enhances your playstyle. But is this a good roguelite? Eh, it’s okay. There are not a lot of choices with build options and I found most of the upgrades to be brainless or boring. I spent time doing runs with all 4 classes and my favorite one was the witch with the broom. I felt like she had the most cohesive build potential and interesting playstyle. The other 3 were mostly just variations of perfect dodging and charge attacks. As for difficulty, I think the game is fairly difficult. It took me about 10ish runs before I got 1 win. Most of the difficulty comes down to lack of defense or healing abilities. This plays somewhat like a bullethell in that you have to be constantly dodging in order to survive. Oh, and the prize for a win? Harder difficulty. [h1] [b] Graphics (Quality/Technical) – [6/10] [/b] [/h1] Not bad, but it does feel a bit cheap or more indie-like. I’d say this is around PS3-era visuals. Technical side, I did notice a few hiccups, especially when you load into a run for the first time, I kept getting a solid ~1 second lag/pause time. I was playing with everything fully maxed. I didn’t notice any bugs. 1440p @ 240hz | installed on SSD [h1] [b] Audio – [7/10] [/b] [/h1] Good music, each stage brings a different tune and they are all addictively hummable. There is voice acting, but it’s all in Japanese. [h1] [b] Replay Factor (Longevity) – [6/10] [/b] [/h1] There’s some definite potential here, being a roguelite with a bunch of unlocks is a positive. I’m not sure how deep this goes though. [h1] [b] Final Verdict – [5/10] [/b] [/h1] Touhou Dystopian is a rogueLITE game where you complete runs with anime girls to unlock powers and advantages. As far as roguelites go, I didn’t find this to be very exciting. The 4 classes have balance issues where one of them feels stronger and another feels weaker than the rest. Furthermore, the build potential across all the characters just wasn’t fun or interesting enough. Add in that every run feels the same with the same stage order and same boss order, and it's a recipe for repetition. Of the 4 characters, the only one that felt fleshed out was the witch with the broom. Her build potential seemed great as it focused on her unique charge and range attack. Unfortunately, it felt like the others didn’t get the same love and attention bringing the choice potential from 4 to 1 for me. The combat feels like a watered-down Nier Automata. You attack with left click and have your ranged attack (auto target) with right click. It’s simple and none of the classes, barring witch girl, do enough differently to take advantage of this combat system. Overall, it’s a tough call to make, but I would go with a not recommended. After almost 5 hours and 1 win I didn’t feel like there was enough variety or potential for me to move on to the higher difficulty. It’s not a bad game though, I’d say it’s just a bit rough and unexciting. [h1] [b] Recommend? (Price) [Y/N] [/b] [/h1] [h1]No[/h1] $10 base price is fair given the content. This is one of the very few third-person action roguelites I know, and I had a lot of fun with it. The combat is on point. Every character has their own fighting style, and I like that the game rewards you with extra Gems for picking a random character. It gives you a reason to play someone other than your favorite. The progression is also well balanced. Your character becomes stronger through perks, companions, and upgrades, while you also improve with every run. But it never reaches the point where you can just turn your brain off and win. I do wish the game had a bit more polish though. Fighting the bosses in the same order every run gets repetitive. I'd love to see a way to randomize them. The first bosses become easy simply because you've fought them so many times, while the later ones stay harder because you barely get to practice them. There is a practice mode, but I usually end up just playing normal runs instead since setting up a build for every practice attempt feels a bit clunky. Combat is a little inconsistent too. Some enemies flash almost a second before attacking, while others barely give you any warning at all. Since the timing isn't consistent, reacting to the flash can be misleading. If you instinctively dodge when you see the flash and you'll get hit anyway when the attack finally lands. I also got hit during dashes sometimes, and some fights, especially Yuyuko and Remilia, fill the screen with so many effects that it's hard to tell what's going on. These are mostly nitpicks though. For around €10, this is a really solid game to pick up every now and then.

TOUHOU DYSTOPIAN IS A PEAK ROGUELIKE MADE BY FANS FOR FANS! REVIEWED ON: (GeForce GT 1030/i7-3770 ) ✨ Honestly this game had me surprised from the start, and I did try this one off-Steam way back. Preserves it's Touhou vibes and difficulty while introducing us to a new combat perspective similar to that of NieR:Automata, and fun replayability. The game's performance is great, although the camera can be annoying for many sometimes. There is a learning curve to it all, and the game is not easy nor hard, but define by your style as a player, the choices you make, and how fast and smart you are after experiencing defeat. While I'm a fan of Touhou, it's lore, and Waifus, I'm always rusty at the games since it's not like I'm playing them nonstop, compared to other people who prioritize them and enjoy the tough gameplay. Took me a while to reach Alice Margatroid boss, and that's where I left off for now. This said, from what I experience so far the game is quite enjoyable for fans and non-fans probably. ✨ This is an action roguelike, so expect yourself to be constantly entering rooms/dungeons, fighting minor waves or enemies to get resources, upgrade your stats or skills before entering the next room, and eventually fight a boss to earn the rewards, until you reach the endgame. The game is balanced, and the more you fall to your death , the more you learn about yourself, your patience, your current skill level, and how you will deal with everything in order to progress. Which each failure, you'll be granted certain advantages before starting all over again. From unlocking new posibilities, upgrades, lucky or unlucky events, and characters to meeting and unlocking companions that will aid you on your journey while buffing you. So even if you fall, as many games in this genre, you can expect to look forward to unique content until you unlock everything available on the shops, get stronger, and experience all the game has to offer. ✨ WHAT I DIDN'T LIKE: Even if you can play as Youmu and unlock certain playable characters, you won't be able to play all Touhou Waifus shown in the game, nor can you expect to play as some of the oens you truly love. I hope the dev can actually implement this later. Being able to play as the companions you come across in certain rooms and invite to help you out would be cool. Playing as the bosses featured will feel off perhaps, considering you basically fight against the same bosses chronologically. I found the fact that both Reisen and Reimu were not playable real damn sad, they are in my top 10 fave Touhou gurls. And personally, playing as Reisen and her skill set would feel goated in any game. Asides this, I did not find anything else I would consider negative from my point of view. Then again, I'm just giving that -1 for being a Simp. For those wondering, I did some research out of curiosity: ✨ COMPANIONS FEATURED: Reisen, Reimu, Koishi, Meiling, and Sagume. ✨ CHARACTER PLAYABLE: Youmu, Marisa,Fujiwara no Mokou, Flandre. -All in all the game is quite a blast for anyone wanting an interesting and intense Roguelike experience that puts one to the test, another Touhou game for the library, or those who prefer difficulty over easy and fast games. Also, anyone who faves Youmu or any of the gurls playable. 9/10-10/10 -Enjoyable, but would feel more at home for me if Reisen and Reimu were playable.
